description: Public Transport Stations is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport Authority. This data includes details of public transport stations such as number of public transport stations, the names of public transport stations, the address of public transport stations, and the geographical location of public transport stations. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal files it under Transport and infrastructure. The portal shows 12 records. The portal shows 2026-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
